sloka: किं निमित्तमिमं देशं कृष्णाजिनजटाधर: ।हित्वा राज्यं प्रविष्टस्त्वं तत्सर्वं वक्तुमर्हसि ॥ २.१०४.३॥
transliteration: kiṁ nimittamimaṁ deśaṁ kṛṣṇājinajaṭādhara: ।hitvā rājyaṁ praviṣṭastvaṁ tatsarvaṁ vaktumarhasi ॥ 2.104.3॥

translations.english: What made you come to this region, leaving the kingdom and wearing deer skin and matted hair? You should tell me everything.
